assignmentHtml.task:
全面调查 ABS-CBN Entertainment 的 YouTube 频道。查明以下事项：

  1. 稳定频道 ID 及规范 URL。
  2. 运营方：ABS-CBN Corporation。企业隶属关系链。
  3. 频道创建日期，以及目前仍公开的最早上传视频。
  4. 运营地点及频道显示的国家。
  5. 使用的语言（菲律宾语／英语）。
  6. 主要内容类别（菲律宾电视娱乐）。
  7. 内容供应模式：广播电视机构的节目存档。
  8. 代表性系列。提供直接来源 URL。
assignmentHtml.context: 根据 Communitrics 于 2026 年 9 月 2 日的快照，ABS-CBN Entertainment 排名第 39 名，历史累计观看量约为 60B（600 亿）次。需要可核实的事实，并附来源链接。
assignmentHtml.expected_output: 一份关于 ABS-CBN Entertainment 的结构化资料，包含全部要求的字段，每个字段均附来源 URL。

answerHtml:
ABS-CBN Entertainment YouTube Channel — Structured Dossier

(1) Stable Channel ID and Canonical URL
• Channel ID: UCstEtN0pgOmCf02EdXsGChw (confirmed via streamscharts.com URL structure)
• Canonical URL: https://www.youtube.com/abscbnentertainment
• Handle: @abscbnentertainment
Source: https://streamscharts.com/channels/UCstEtN0pgOmCf02EdXsGChw?platform=youtube ; https://www.youtube.com/abscbnentertainment

(2) Operator and Corporate Chain
• Operated by: ABS-CBN Corporation (the Philippines' leading media and entertainment organization)
• Corporate chain: ABS-CBN Corporation is a subsidiary of Lopez Holdings Corporation (56.28% ownership); additional owners are ABS-CBN Holdings Corporation (32.21%) and public shareholders (42.80%). ABS-CBN itself was formed from the 1953 merger of Alto Broadcasting System and Chronicle Broadcasting Network.
• ABS-CBN Entertainment is not a separately incorporated entity; it is the entertainment-branded YouTube channel of ABS-CBN Corporation, whose main entertainment division is the Star Creatives Group.
Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ABS-CBN_Corporation ; https://servicesdirectory.withyoutube.com/directory/abs-cbn-corporation/

(3) Channel Creation Date and Earliest Still-Public Upload
• Created: Joined July 15, 2008 (per YouTube's own About-page metadata: "Joined Jul 15, 2008"; Social Blade reports July 16, 2008, likely a UTC/PHT timezone difference)
• Earliest verified still-public upload: "ABS-CBN Christmas Station ID 2009 'Bro, Ikaw ang Star ng Pasko'" uploaded November 4, 2009 (80.6M views). This is the oldest upload I could independently confirm on the channel. Note: The channel has 262K+ videos and may contain earlier uploads from 2008–early 2009 that are unlisted, removed, or not indexable by search; this gap is acknowledged as unresolved.
Sources: https://www.youtube.com/abscbnentertainment/about (snippet: "Joined Jul 15, 2008"); https://socialblade.com/youtube/handle/abscbnentertainment ; https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=T1nNUOMS14g

(4) Operating Location and Displayed Country
• Operating location: Eugenio Lopez Jr. Communications Center, Eugenio Lopez St., Quezon City, 1103, Metro Manila, Philippines
• Displayed country: Philippines (🇵🇭 / PH, ranked #1 in the Philippines by Communitrics)
Sources: https://servicesdirectory.withyoutube.com/directory/abs-cbn-corporation/ ; https://www.viewstats.com/@abscbnentertainment/channelytics ; https://top.communitrics.com/top-100-most-subscribed-youtube-channels-in-philippines

(5) Languages
• Primary: Filipino (main language of broadcasting per Wikipedia)
• Secondary: English
• YouTube Services Directory lists: English, English (UK), Tagalog
Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ABS-CBN ; https://servicesdirectory.withyoutube.com/directory/abs-cbn-corporation/

(6) Primary Content Category
• YouTube category: Entertainment (#28 globally in Entertainment; #1 in the Philippines; ranked #86 globally by subscribers as of Sept 2026)
• Described as: most subscribed media & entertainment channel in Southeast Asia (2025 data)
Sources: https://www.viewstats.com/@abscbnentertainment/channelytics ; https://corporate.abs-cbn.com/newsroom/news-releases/2026/1/26/abs-cbn-sets-digital-record-on-youtube-facebook-tiktok-ig-and-x?lang=en ; https://top.communitrics.com/top-100-most-subscribed-youtube-channels-in-philippines

(7) Content Supply Model
• Broadcaster archives: The channel distributes full episodes, highlights, exclusive videos, and livestreams (Kapamilya Online Live) drawn directly from ABS-CBN's television programming library — classic and contemporary TV series, variety shows, news programs, station IDs, and movies. Overseas distribution is organized under "Kapamilya Online Live Global" with English subtitles.
Sources: https://corporate.abs-cbn.com/newsroom/news-releases/2021/10/18/classic-abs-cbn-tv-series-and-exclusive-youtube-sh?lang=en ; https://corporate.abs-cbn.com/newsroom/news-releases/2026/1/26/abs-cbn-sets-digital-record-on-youtube-facebook-tiktok-ig-and-x?lang=en

(8) Representative Series
• Long-running: It's Showtime, ASAP Natin 'To, TV Patrol, MMK
• Hit dramas: What Lies Beneath, Roja, FPJ's Ang Batang Quiapo, Doble Kara
• Classic series (overseas feed): May Bukas Pa, Prinsesa ng Banyera, Sabel, Dyosa, Hiram, Palibhasa Lalake, Banana Split
• Anthology/reality: Maalaala Mo Kaya, Your Face Sounds Familiar, Rainbow Rumble
Sources: https://corporate.abs-cbn.com/newsroom/news-releases/2026/1/26/abs-cbn-sets-digital-record-on-youtube-facebook-tiktok-ig-and-x?lang=en ; https://corporate.abs-cbn.com/newsroom/news-releases/2021/10/18/classic-abs-cbn-tv-series-and-exclusive-youtube-sh?lang=en

(9) Key Metrics (as of mid-September 2026)
• Subscribers: ~55.2M (#1 in Philippines, #86 globally)
• Lifetime views: ~60B (59.96B per Social Blade as of Sept 17, 2026; ~59.8B per Communitrics FAQ)
• Video count: ~262K–263K
• Communitrics snapshot (Sept 2, 2026): #1 in Philippines ranking, ~55M subs, ~60B views — consistent with the orchestrator's "~60B" figure.
Sources: https://socialblade.com/youtube/handle/abscbnentertainment ; https://top.communitrics.com/top-100-most-subscribed-youtube-channels-in-philippines ; https://www.viewstats.com/@abscbnentertainment/channelytics
